name: Naksh Precious Metals Ltd
about: Incorporated in 2003, Naksh Precious Metals Ltd is engaged in Manufacturing and distribution of jewellery products[1]
keyPoints:
Business Overview:[1]
NPML manufactures and distributes Metal Products, Steel Products, Trading Products & Jewellery Products. It caters to international markets and provides value-driven activities including steel finishing services, custom-made solutions, and shipping services.

pros: Stock is trading at 0.85 times its book value
cons: Company has a low return on equity of 2.65% over last 3 years.
